remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this meticulously maintained and updated in-town Cape. Flooded with natural light, this charming home features gorgeous wood floors, a welcoming living room with a fireplace, and a dedicated dining room with a cozy sitting area. With three wonderful bedrooms, two full baths, and a convenient location just a short walk to the train, town, and Mead Park, this residence offers an enviable lifestyle. Enjoy outdoor relaxation in your private yard with a patio, and benefit from the added peace of mind provided by a house generator. The finished basement offers extra utility with a washer, dryer, sink, and freezer, completing this fabulous in-town gem.
